q: The concept of a Toeplitz sequence in topological dynamics: a sequence x ∈ A^ℤ is Toeplitz if for every position n ∈ ℤ, there exists a period p > 0 such that x(n) = x(n+kp) for all k ∈ ℤ (each position is 'periodic', but with different periods). Toeplitz subshifts are:
opts: Minimal and almost 1-to-1 extensions of their maximal equicontinuous factor (an odometer)
exp: Toeplitz subshifts are minimal (the orbit closure of a Toeplitz sequence) and almost 1-to-1 extensions of an odometer (an inverse limit of cyclic groups). They have zero entropy and serve as examples of minimal but non-uniquely ergodic systems (in some cases).
